offering_description.value: Manufactures and sells nitrogen-based chemicals including ammonia, fertilizers (UAN, ammonium nitrate) and industrial and mining chemicals such as nitric acid and ammonium nitrate for explosives. Customers are agricultural distributors, industrial users and mining companies. Products are made at its own chemical plants in the US Midwest and South.

primary_products.value: ammonia; urea ammonium nitrate fertilizer; ammonium nitrate; nitric acid; sulfuric acid

customer_segment.value: B2B: agricultural distributors and co-ops, mining and explosives companies, industrial manufacturers, water treatment users

end_markets.value: agriculture; mining; industrial chemicals; water treatment

revenue_model.value: product sales: nitrogen fertilizers, ammonia and industrial and mining chemicals sold by volume

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts natural gas and other feedstocks into nitrogen chemicals at own plants, sold to agricultural, industrial and mining customers

geography_served.value: US national: Mainly central and southern US agricultural regions and Gulf Coast, plus some exports

specialization.value: related lines: agricultural, industrial and mining nitrogen chemicals from shared nitrogen production

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: industrial and mining customers under supply contracts; distributors / dealers: agricultural distributors and fertilizer retailers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Environmental, process safety and chemical security rules from EPA, OSHA and DHS covering ammonia and ammonium nitrate
